description: A progress bar (DESIGN.md, Progress): TsuyaSpace.s4 tall (thin: 2), TsuyaRadius.full, TsuyaColors.track filled with the accent, proportional to value (0 to 1). Without value, a third of the bar sweeps across the track every 1.2 s, in the reading direction, kept moving under reduced motion: it is the information. Always named, with label (the `loading` label by default), through the progress bar role.

constructors.description: A progress bar, value from 0 to 1; indeterminate without one.

params.name: value
params.description: 0 to 1 (clamped to it); indeterminate without one, or when NaN.

params.name: label
params.description: Names the bar; the `loading` label by default.
